method: Three rounds of alternating baseline/current workers. Compare medians of worker medians. Host variation remains; tiny frozen-parser differences are not significant.
reproduction: Save driver_source to build/small-parser-benchmark.php. Copy the eight changed source files from git show 0ea7613:<path> to build/baseline-small/<path>. Run php build/small-parser-benchmark.php <email|phone|uri> <frozen|facade> <baseline|current>, alternating workers for three rounds.
driver_source:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
require __DIR__ . '/../vendor/autoload.php';
if (($argv[3] ?? '') === 'baseline') {
    spl_autoload_register(static function (string $class): void {
        $prefix = 'Vanderlee\\Comprehend\\';
        if (str_starts_with($class, $prefix)) {
            $file = __DIR__ . '/baseline-small/src/' . str_replace('\\', '/', substr($class, strlen($prefix))) . '.php';
            if (is_file($file)) { require $file; }
        }
    }, true, true);
}
use Vanderlee\Comprehend\Comprehend as C;
use Vanderlee\Comprehend\Library\Rfc3986;
use Vanderlee\Comprehend\Parser\Terminal\Text;
use Vanderlee\Comprehend\Parser\Terminal\Regex;
use Vanderlee\Comprehend\Parser\Structure\Sequence;
use Vanderlee\Comprehend\Result\ParseResult;

$kind=$argv[1];$path=$argv[2];
$local='[A-Za-z0-9_+%\-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_+%\-]+)*';
$domain='(?:[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,63}';
$phone='\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}';
$native= $kind==='email' ? '/\A'.$local.'@'.$domain.'\z/' : '/\A'.$phone.'\z/';
$factory=static function() use($kind,$local,$domain,$phone) {
    if($kind==='uri') {return C::of((new Rfc3986())->ref('URI'));}
    if($kind==='phone') {return C::of((new Regex('/'.$phone.'/A'))->name('number')->mapValue(
        static fn(ParseResult $r)=>['international'=>$r->rawText(),'digits'=>substr($r->rawText(),1)]));}
    return C::of((new Sequence((new Regex('/'.$local.'/A'))->name('local'),new Text('@'),
        (new Regex('/'.$domain.'/A'))->name('domain')))->name('email')->mapValue(
        static fn(ParseResult $r)=>['local'=>$r->node->children[0]->rawText(),'domain'=>$r->node->children[2]->rawText()]));
};
$cases=match($kind) {
    'email'=>[['alice@example.com',true],['jane.doe+news@example.co.uk',true],['a_b@example.org',true],['x@sub.example.net',true],
        ['alice..smith@example.com',false],['alice@-example.com',false],['alice@example',false],['alice@example.com ',false]],
    'phone'=>[['+31612345678',true],['+442079460958',true],['+12025550123',true],['+819012345678',true],
        ['+0123456789',false],['+1234',false],['+31 612345678',false],['+1234567890123456',false]],
    'uri'=>[['https://example.com',true],['https://example.com/caf%C3%A9?q=hello%20world#top',true],
        ['http://[2001:db8::1]:8080/a',true],['mailto:alice@example.com',true],['example.com/path',false],
        ['https://example.com/%ZZ',false],['https://example.com/a b',false],['http://[::1',false]],
};
$start=hrtime(true);$facade=$factory();$built=hrtime(true);$frozen=$facade->freeze();$prepared=hrtime(true);
$rows=[];
foreach($cases as [$input,$expected]) {
    $checked=$frozen->parseAll($input);
    if($checked->success!==$expected){
        $rows[]=['input'=>$input,'valid'=>$expected,'actual'=>$checked->success,'acceptance_mismatch'=>true,
            'farthest_failure'=>$checked->farthestFailure,'expected'=>$checked->diagnostic?->expected];
        unset($checked);
        continue;
    }
    unset($checked);
    $run=static function() use($path,$factory,$facade,$frozen,$input,$expected,$native) {
        if($path==='native') {$success=preg_match($native,$input)===1;}
        else {
            $grammar=match($path) {'rebuild'=>$factory(),'facade'=>$facade,default=>$frozen};
            $result=$grammar->parseAll($input);$success=$result->success;
            if($success && $path==='ast') {$output=$result->ast();if($output===null){throw new RuntimeException('AST missing');}}
            if($success && $path==='value') {$output=$result->value();if($output===null){throw new RuntimeException('Value missing');}}
            if($success && $result->consumedByteLength!==strlen($input)){throw new RuntimeException('Consumption changed');}
        }
        if($success!==$expected){throw new RuntimeException('Acceptance mismatch: '.$input);}
    };
    for($i=0;$i<10;++$i){$run();}
    $samples=[];$peak=0;
    for($sample=0;$sample<7;++$sample){
        gc_collect_cycles();memory_reset_peak_usage();$startSample=hrtime(true);
        for($i=0;$i<10;++$i){$run();}
        $samples[]=(hrtime(true)-$startSample)/1e6/10;$peak=max($peak,memory_get_peak_usage(true));
    }
    sort($samples);
    $rows[]=['input'=>$input,'valid'=>$expected,'bytes'=>strlen($input),'median_ms'=>$samples[3],
        'min_ms'=>$samples[0],'max_ms'=>$samples[6],'allocated_process_peak'=>$peak];
}
echo json_encode(['kind'=>$kind,'path'=>$path,'php'=>PHP_VERSION,'pcre'=>PCRE_VERSION,'revision'=>'0ea7613',
    'code'=>$argv[3]??'current',
    'construction_ms'=>($built-$start)/1e6,'freeze_ms'=>($prepared-$built)/1e6,
    'warmup_calls_per_input'=>10,'samples'=>7,'calls_per_sample'=>10,
    'timing'=>'Includes fresh UTF-8 source, parsing, requested projection, assertions and result release; excludes autoload and process startup',
    'results'=>$rows],JSON_PRETTY_PRINT|JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),"\n";
